desc:
Take to the waters and destroy the enemy, or man the cannons and defend your fort with your team! Raid the enemy ships, raid their fort!

Get cash by blowing up the enemy ships and fort! Use your cash to purchase new, bigger, better ships! Or use your cash to get awesome effects and skins!

Shift + P to enable freecam mode.
